description: Recent earthquakes worldwide from the US Geological Survey: magnitude, place, time, depth, coordinates, tsunami flag and USGS link, for the past day or week, filtered by minimum magnitude (2.5, 4.5 or significant). Use for alerts, news and travel checks. Example: period=day, minMagnitude=4.5. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
